problem: The vector $u$ has magnitude $1$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $11,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${27}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to the nearest integer where appropriate.

feedback.problem: The vector $u$ has magnitude $6$, the vector $v$ has magnitude $7,$ the angle between $u$ and $v$ is ${134}^{∘}$ and $n$ is the unit vector that points in the direction of $u\times v.$ Find $u\times v$ in terms of $n.$ Round your final answer to one decimal place where appropriate.
feedback.worked_solution:
We use the formula for the cross product and obtain

$$
\begin{aligned}u\times v & =|u|\cdot |v|\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡\theta \cdot n \\  & =6\cdot 7\cdot \operatorname{sin}⁡{134}^{∘}\cdot n \\  & =42\cdot (0.719\,33…)\cdot n \\  & =(30.212\,27…)\cdot n \\  & ≈30.2n.\end{aligned}
$$
